← Variant dashboard

Road surfaces and lights

32 before / after studies. Current game layouts, 20 × 7 cells. Concepts change surfaces and lamps; they are not applied to gameplay.

New paving patterns use native pixel geometry. Light posts reuse game sprites. Worn / restored applies to both sides.

Garden setts
